name: answer-beacon
description: Check your built static site is ready for answer engines (AEO): question headings with concise direct answers, FAQPage/QAPage/HowTo schema, llms.txt, AI crawler rules in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) and meta tags, and author/date E-E-A-T signals. SARIF, allowlist, GitHub Action. Zero deps.
author: Louis Wright <hello@louiswright.co.uk> (https://github.com/MrLouisWright)
